notes: Tail case re-examined. U1 recoloured the whole truck (white box, blue cage and cargo) ambiguously; now recolours only the white cab, with a SAM3 cab mask (v2). U2 removed an entire building (ill-posed); retargeted (same remove op) to the red shop lettering above the storefront, SAM3 mask (v2).
